tool_args.rationale: The six observations do not identify a sufficiently accurate mechanism: the recalled siphon baseline misses several points by more than the tolerance. The additional trajectory batch is the remaining relevant probe for distinguishing smooth mechanisms before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the recalled subcritical siphon formula
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Its three-coefficient fit has residuals near 0.1 on several observations, exceeding the requested tolerance; the governing dependence remains ambiguous.
The observed gradient dependence is not captured by the recalled Haldane law, and six confounded points do not establish a Cobb–Douglas mechanism.
That probe has already supplied its discriminating observation; a trajectory batch can add more information about the remaining ambiguity.
It is not relevant to identifying the response law.
